title: Predicting Custom-Feed Returns for New Bluesky Posts: A Prospective Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.13874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The conventional approach to cold-start recommendation addresses new users or newly introduced items. Bluesky custom feeds create a different setting: independently operated feeds filter content from a shared public stream. In this setting, newly published posts are the cold-start objects, while the feeds serve as candidates. We propose a cold-start routing task in which a newly ingested public post is the query and all rankable feeds in the monitored panel are ranked according to whether each will subsequently return it. We build a still-evolving collect-first, label-later benchmark dataset. The collected dataset covers a fixed panel of 5,000 monitored feeds and contains 17.804 million public posts, 1.865 million observable post--feed return records, and 625,083 valid feed polls. translated_title: 预测新Bluesky帖子自定义源回报的前瞻性研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13874v1 公告类型：新 摘要：传统的冷启动推荐方法针对新用户或新引入的物品。Bluesky自定义源创建了一种不同的设置：独立运营的源从共享公共流中过滤内容。在这种设置下，新发布的帖子是冷启动对象，而源则作为候选。我们提出了一种冷启动路由任务，其中新摄入的公共帖子作为查询，并根据每个源是否会随后返回该帖子，对监控面板中所有可排序的源进行排序。我们构建了一个仍在演变中的“先收集、后标记”基准数据集。收集的数据集覆盖了一个固定的5,000个监控源面板，包含1780.4万条公共帖子、186.5万条可观察的帖子-源回报记录，以及625,083次有效的源投票。标签记录了一个帖子在发布后24小时内是否至少一次出现在某个源的AppView前50名结果中。当前实验...
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对Bluesky自定义源的新冷启动路由任务，通过构建大规模基准数据集来预测新帖子是否会被特定源返回，从而解决独立源过滤场景下的内容推荐问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel cold-start routing task for Bluesky custom feeds, building a large-scale benchmark dataset to predict whether new posts will be returned by specific feeds, addressing content recommendation in independently operated feed filtering scenarios.
